description: Take E006's schedule unchanged: 9.0 epochs, epochs 0-3 low-res, 4-6 at 28 px, 7-8 at 32 px. Make exactly two changes, which together are the H2.5 confound removal: (a) the first phase uses 26 px instead of 24 px, and (b) replace random-resized crop with flip + translate-2 at 32 px followed by an antialiased bilinear downsample to the phase resolution. Warm up all shapes in build.
